result.title: PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems
result.comment: CONVERSATIONS 2026, International Symposium on Chatbots and Human-Centred AI, Preprint
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for evaluating the behavior of chatbots and other AI systems. In deployment, however, their agreement with the intended human evaluation policy may degrade as user interactions and score distributions change. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods are primarily studied as one-shot procedures on static development sets and therefore provide limited guidance for maintaining LLM judges over time. We frame this problem as judge drift and introduce PromptOps, a closedloop framework for monitoring and iteratively recalibrating LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaaJ) systems. PromptOps separates four operational decisions: when to optimize, which optimization procedure to apply, which feedback records to use, and how to update the judge prompt. We instantiate the framework with five prompt optimization methods: GEPA, SIMBA, Rubric Synthesis, and exemplar selection using either simulated annealing or a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator. Our experiments demonstrate that iterative prompt optimization can recalibrate LLM judges and recover performance after controlled shifts in the referencescore distribution. However, effective maintenance is inherently contextdependent: neither optimization algorithm choice nor update timing generalizes universally across settings. These findings establish prompt optimization for deployed LLM judges as an inherently iterative maintenance problem and demonstrate that PromptOps provides a practical abstraction for studying and implementing this process.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把部署中 LLM-as-a-Judge 与预期人类评价标准逐渐失配的问题称为「judge drift」，提出闭环框架 PromptOps，将「何时优化、用哪种优化流程、用哪些反馈记录、如何更新判分提示」拆为四类决策，并以 GEPA、SIMBA、评分规则合成与样例选择等五种方法在受控分数分布漂移下检验重校准效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 属评价运维而非 latent 推理本身，但其「何时触发优化」与反馈记录筛选机制，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的在线评判漂移监测及重评/停止决策提供类比线索，可供核查触发策略是否可迁移。
